finding: We tested whether a noisy mechanical reply retains predictive value when the reader accounts for its reliability. All 3,454 deterministic files match across the original run and both complete replays. Independent numerical reconstruction is source admitted after 19 isolated controls; predictive rankings and numerical selection sensitivity remain unaccepted. This is a supplied-law constructed-method comparison, not evidence of learned access or human intent.
